root.id = Solidity.SolkeyAgreementH28.Controls.copied.val.id ∧
  Solidity.SolkeyAgreementH28.Fresh [Solidity.RefTy.array Solidity.Ty.uint] root.id ∧

              Solidity.SolkeyAgreementH28.Controls.emptyArr ⋯).H'
